data.summary: A practical guide to marbella boat rental group size limits, covering every boat in our fleet from 5 to 12 passengers. Includes key facts, pricing tiers, and FAQs to help you choose the right vessel.
key_facts: Our fleet accommodates 5 to 12 passengers per boat.
Smallest boats: Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) and Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax).
Largest boats: Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) and Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax).

faq.q: What is the maximum group size for a marbella boat rental?
faq.a: The maximum group size is 12 passengers on boats like the Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, and Canados 86. Smaller boats (e.g., Dubhe, Mariah SX21) take up to 5 passengers. Always check the specific capacity before booking.

faq.q: Can I rent a boat for 8 people in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes. Boats like the Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) and Red Tide (11m, 6 pax) are ideal for groups of 6–8. For 8–10 passengers, consider the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) or the Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax).

faq.q: Which boat is best for 10 passengers?
faq.a: Good options include the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax), Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax), Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax), and Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax). All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Is there a boat for 12 passengers in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes. Several boats carry up to 12 passengers: Mangusta 80 (24m), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m), Canados 86 (26m), Ferretti 94 (29m), K80 (24m), Mangusta 80 Grey (24m), and Maiora 26m (26m). All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Are children counted in the passenger limit?
faq.a: Yes. All passengers, including infants and children, count towards the maximum capacity. This is a safety regulation. For families, choose a boat with extra capacity relative to your group size.

faq.q: What is included in the price for a marbella boat rental?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees.

faq.q: How much does a boat rental for 12 people cost?
faq.a: Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 (12 pax) start at €4,719 for 4 hours, including a jet ski. Tier A boats (max 11 pax) cost from €749 for 2 hours to €2,299 for 8 hours. For other 12-pax boats, pricing is on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can I split a large group across two boats?
faq.a: Yes. If your group exceeds 12 passengers, you can charter two boats simultaneously. Contact us via WhatsApp to coordinate departures and itineraries for a seamless experience.

Choosing the right marbella boat rental group size is the first step to a perfect day on the water. Our fleet ranges from intimate 5-person speedboats to spacious 12-person luxury yachts—all departing from Puerto Banús. Whether you're planning a family outing, a corporate event, or a party with friends, here's exactly which boat fits your group.

Boat capacity at a glance

Every boat in our fleet has a strict passenger limit based on its safety certification. Here are the capacities by boat type:

Small groups: 5–6 passengers

For couples, small families, or a tight-knit group of friends, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax), Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax), Speedboat (7m, 6 pax), and Red Tide (11m, 6 pax) are ideal. These boats are nimble and perfect for a quick 2-hour spin along the Marbella coastline or a sunset cruise to Cala del Faro. All include a skipper, drinks, and snacks.

Medium groups: 8–10 passengers

Groups of 8–10 will find plenty of options. The Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) is a sporty choice, while the Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax) and Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) offer more space and comfort. For a catamaran experience, the Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax) provides stability and a large deck area. These boats are great for day trips to Cabopino or Estepona.

Large groups: 11–12 passengers

If you have 11 or 12 people, you're in the sweet spot for our fleet. The Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) is a Tier A option, costing €749/2h to €2,299/8h. For 12 passengers, choose from the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m), Mangusta 80 (24m), Canados 86 (26m), Ferretti 94 (29m), K80 (24m), Mangusta 80 Grey (24m), or Maiora 26m (26m). The Mangusta 80 (Tier B) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski—perfect for thrill-seekers.

Pricing by group size

Our pricing is transparent and based on the boat tier, not per person. Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) costs €749 for 2 hours and €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, and VAT. Tier B (Mangusta 80) has a minimum 4-hour charter at €4,719, with a jet ski included. For all other boats, contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. Every booking includes fuel, insurance, and all listed amenities—no extra fees.

Tips for booking the right boat

  • Count everyone – infants and children count toward the limit.
  • Consider comfort – a boat rated for 12 will feel spacious for 10 but cosy for 12.
  • Check the itinerary – longer trips (8h) to Sotogrande or Cala Cortés suit larger yachts.
  • Book early – peak season sees high demand for 12-pax boats.
